summary:
The 27
Since its inception over a generation ago, the Fuel Oil/Energy Buyers' Conference hosted by Poten & Partners and Frank Swierz Associates has grown into the premier gathering of the world's fuel oil and energy buyers as well as energy service providers. This year's conference will be held October 29-31 and has maintained its traditional Miami Beach, FL location. While dwarfed by crude oil movements, fuel oil is still a pretty big business.
